title: Monogram Beverage Mugs Recalled by Tri-Vista Designs Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Kirkland's
summary: If used in the microwave, the metallic mugs can spark, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 10,000.

title: Ramart Recalls Swing Chairs Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at HomeGoods Stores
summary: The swing chairs can tip over, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 250.

title: Walgreens Vitamins Recalled by International Vitamin Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: The packaging is not child-resistant and senior friendly as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The multivitamin supplement tablets inside the bottle contain iron, which can cause serious injury or death to young children if multiple tablets are ingested at once. Units: About 17,000.

title: Pali Design Recalls Children's Furniture Due to Tip-Over, Impact, Suffocation Hazards
summary: The plastic restraint strap used to attach armoires, combos, dressers and hutches to a wall can break and allow the unit to tip over. Falling furniture can result in a wide range of injuries to young children, from soft tissue bruising to broken bones, head injuries and death by suffocation when a c

title: Bariatric Fusion Recalls Bags of Soft Chews Iron With Vitamin C Due To Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirement (Recall Alert)
summary: The packaging is not child-resistant and senior friendly as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The chews inside the package contain iron, which can cause serious injury or death to young children if multiple chews are ingested. Units: About 800.

title: Big Lots Recalls Hanging Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The hanging chairs can tip over when they face sideways and swing beyond the base, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 16,000.

title: Cree Recalls LED T8 Lamps Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Electrical arcing may cause the lamp to overheat and melt, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 700,000 in the U.S. (an additional 11,500 were sold in Canada).

title: Apple Recalls Beats Pill XL Portable Wireless Speakers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 222,000 in the U.S. (and about 11,000 in Canada).

title: A.O. Smith Recalls John Wood Brand Oil-Fired Water Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The water heater's combustion chamber can be misaligned and heat the exterior walls of the water heater instead of the water. Combustible material near the outside of the water heater can catch fire, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 250.

title: ORTOVOX Recalls Avalanche Transceiver Due to Loss of Emergency Communications Capability
summary: The S1+ hardware can fail, resulting in an inability to transmit a discoverable signal during an emergency situation, even as the unit appears to be powered on and functioning properly. Units: About 3,000.

title: Northern Tool + Equipment Recalls Little Digger Toy Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The red paint on the Little Digger toy frame contains excessive levels of lead, which is prohibited under federal law. Units: About 7,000.

title: Tops with Elastic Draw Cords Recalled by lululemon athletica Due to Injury Hazard
summary: When the elastic draw cord with a hard tip in the hood or around the neck area is pulled or caught on something and released, it can snap back, impact the face area and result in injury. Units: About 133,000 in the United States and 185,000 in Canada.

title: Bicycles with SR Suntour Bicycle Forks Recalled by SR Suntour Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The bolt that attaches the upper part of the bicycle's fork to the lower part of the fork can break or separate and cause the front wheel to come off the bicycle. This is a crash hazard for riders. Units: About 68,000 in the United States and 33,600 in Canada.

title: Positec Tool Recalls Worx Brand Blower/Vacs Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The grounded and ungrounded wiring in the electric blower/vacs could be reversed, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 24,300 and 370 in Canada.

title: School Specialty Recalls NeoRok Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The stool can break during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,350.

title: Top Fin Plastic Aquarium Heaters Recalled by PetSmart Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: An electrical problem with the aquarium heaters, poses a risk of fire or electrical shock to the consumer. Units: About 112,200 (33,000 heaters were recalled in August 2014), About 4,800 in Canada.

title: Colnago Recalls Bicycles and Frame Kits Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The front brakes can detach from fork during use, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 400 in the United States and 34 in Canada.

title: Bunnies by the Bay Recalls Pull Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Hub caps on the wheels can break or come off the wheel, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 800 in the United States and 10 in Canada.

title: Coulter Ventures Recalls MobilityWOD Door Anchors Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Rogue Fitness (Recall Alert)
summary: The nylon strap can pull out from the plastic anchor, causing the user to lose balance and fall or the attached hardware to recoil and strike the user, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 875.

title: E-Z-GO Recalls Gas-Powered Golf, Shuttle and Utility Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The gas tank can leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 8,200.

title: Technosport Recalls Omersub Scuba Mask Due to Injury Hazard
summary: Non-conforming glass was used for the lens, which can shatter during normal use, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 2,600.

title: Yamaha Recalls Golf Cars and Personal Transportation Vehicles Due to Risk of Injury, Death (Recall Alert)
summary: The front wheel hubs on the golf cars and PTVs can crack causing the front wheels to detach, posing a crash hazard that could result in injury or death to the user or bystander. Units: About 2,000.

title: Yamaha Recalls SRViper Snowmobiles Due to Injury, Death Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The brake line and its components can come in contact with the clutch causing the brakes to fail, posing a risk of injury or death. Units: About 200.
